notes:
Sepolia only (chain ID 11155111), seven application contracts in dependency order. MockOG is Sepolia-only, with 18 decimals, one trillion initial tokens sent to $owner and unrestricted public minting; never use it on mainnet. MockSwarmPepe is a Sepolia/local-only public-mint ERC721 with no owner. All privileged owners and initial royalty recipients are $owner. Constructors are nonpayable, make no dependency calls and require no initialization calls.

The raffle's owner bootstrap remains necessary: before opening raffles, $owner must call OGClubFurniture.grantMinter(raffle) as furniture's FIRST grant and OGClubStaking.grantSpender(raffle) as staking's FIRST grant, using the confirmed deployed raffle address. Verify minters(raffle) and spenders(raffle). First grants are immediate; later grants activate from proposal+7 days through proposal+14 days inclusive. Revocation is immediate. No manifest operation performs these grants. Staking pointsPerTokenDay is 1000000000000000000 and raffleNotice is 0 on Sepolia. Mainnet uses the existing OG token and RAFFLE_NOTICE=604800. Existing raffle, staking, vault and furniture behavior is unchanged.

OGClubClubs has eleven scalar constructor arguments: token, vault, mint price, furniture, owner, royaltyReceiver, pepes, delegates, level2Price, level3Price, level4Price. The three upgrade prices are separate uint256 inputs because this launch format accepts static string words, not arrays. Mint price is 100000e18; upgrade prices are 200000e18, 400000e18 and 800000e18. Each payment sends half rounded down to the burn sink and the remainder to the vault, with exact debit and receipt checks. The configured delegate.xyz v2 registry is 0x00000000000000447e69651d841bD8D104Bed493; address zero disables delegation. Local tests use a mock registry; no live registry check is claimed.

The Pepe holder or delegate pays and receives club #pepeId; each Pepe mints at most once, including after transfers. Clubs start at level 1 and can be upgraded through level 4 by their holder or approved account. Floors grow from 10x10 to 14x10, then add the x<10,y<16 wing, then fill 16x16. Floor doors (0,4) and (1,4) and side-1 wall position 4 remain clear. Each club holds at most one permanent piece per design, up to 285 distinct pieces (254 floor plus 31 wall). Layouts and levels follow club transfers. Royalty starts at 5% and is bounded at 10%.

The factory leaves the sale closed, footprints unset and URI empty. The owner must configure setFootprint(id,w,h,wall), metadata and setSaleOpen(true). Footprints lock globally after first placement. script/club-footprints.json is a Sepolia example catalogue, not installed by the manifest. Clubs need no minter/spender grant. The mainnet script checks FARM_VAULT.token() equals OG_TOKEN before deploying and broadcasts from DEPLOYER_KEY with OWNER (possibly a Safe) passed directly to the constructor; it prints owner setup calldata and leaves sale closed. It reads SWARM_PEPES, DELEGATE_REGISTRY and three comma-separated UPGRADE_PRICES and deploys neither mock. No deployment, broadcast, signing or factory call was performed.
